channel.title: The Binance hack, October 2026
channel.description: On 29 October 2026 an attacker emptied Binance's hot wallets on ten blockchains in about four hours. Binance puts the impact at around $6.3 billion; three blockchain analytics firms count $6.36 billion to $6.43 billion, the largest crypto theft on record at the value when taken. About $3 billion has been frozen. Binance says it will cover every loss. The analytics firms blame North Korea's TraderTraitor group; Binance and the US government have not confirmed who did it.

item.title: Binance finds "additional points of breach"; withdrawals in 45 hours
item.description: “We are still on track towards the expected timeline to resume the withdrawal service in 45 hours.” Source: https://x.com/binance/status/2116089661408108712

item.title: CEO Richard Teng: "your money is safe"
item.description: “Bottom line - your money is safe, and we're covering every loss.” Source: https://x.com/_RichardTeng/status/2116072080525656150

item.title: Stolen funds meet funds from the Bitget hack
item.description: “This indicates the same actor is likely behind both incidents.” Source: https://x.com/zachxbt/status/2116030284261179538

item.title: Binance puts the impact at around $6.3 billion
item.description: “The estimated total impact sits at around $6.3B.” Source: https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/c5a8729a97ac486d963784d96c5642d7

item.title: Last sweep of new deposits
item.description: “As new funds reached the Binance hot wallet, the operator swept them again at 20:41, 20:59, 21:04, 21:44, 22:39 and 23:56 UTC.” Source: https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-steals-usd-6-36-billion-from-binance-in-the-largest-hack-in-history

item.title: Frozen total passes $2.5 billion
item.description: “Binance said at 23:35 UTC that the verified total frozen had reached USD 2.54 billion.” Source: https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-steals-usd-6-36-billion-from-binance-in-the-largest-hack-in-history

item.title: Second wave: Avalanche and Polygon
item.description: “About two and a half hours later, at 23:05 UTC, Binance wallets on Avalanche and Polygon followed.” Source: https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-steals-usd-6-36-billion-from-binance-in-the-largest-hack-in-history

item.title: Binance's first statement
item.description: “Our teams are aware of reports of a potential security issue and are actively investigating.” Source: https://x.com/binance/status/2115918888429133902

item.title: Binance's co-founder: "It does look like a hack"
item.description: “It does look like a hack on Binance.” Source: https://x.com/cz_binance/status/2115915423174853077

item.title: $2.53 billion leaves Ethereum in a single transaction
item.description: “Two-thirds of the Ethereum losses, $2.53 billion, left in a single transaction at 20:24 UTC.” Source: https://www.elliptic.co/insights/binance-largest-hack-in-history/

item.title: 18,270 bitcoin leave in one transfer; 50 pre-signed authorizations hit Ethereum
item.description: “At 20:20 UTC, a Binance Bitcoin hot wallet sent 18,270 BTC to an attacker address, which began splitting the funds into round 1,000 BTC and 100 BTC pieces inside the same block.” Source: https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-steals-usd-6-36-billion-from-binance-in-the-largest-hack-in-history

item.title: Solana and Optimism wallets follow
item.description: “Binance wallets on Solana and Optimism followed shortly after 20:10 UTC.” Source: https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-steals-usd-6-36-billion-from-binance-in-the-largest-hack-in-history

item.title: First theft: 233 million XRP
item.description: “Between 20:05 and 20:09 UTC, five Binance wallets sent 233.46 million XRP to a single attacker address, leaving each wallet with only its minimum balance.” Source: https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/north-korea-steals-usd-6-36-billion-from-binance-in-the-largest-hack-in-history

item.title: The attacker deploys the contract it will use, four hours ahead
item.description: “At 15:59 UTC on 29 October, the attacker deployed the "sweeper" contract used in the attack, which was rehearsed on another wallet around four hours before it was used against Binance.” Source: https://www.elliptic.co/insights/binance-largest-hack-in-history/
